title: noore chashme dilbare shahe umam paida hua
body:
noore chashme dilbare shaahe umam paida hua
jis ka asghar naam hai wo zee hasham paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
yu'n gale mil mil ke kehte hai malaek quld me
ho mubarak dilbare shaahe umam paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane abid quwwate bazu e hamshakle nabi
baqare zeejaah ek aur amm paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hath me jiske lo wo alhamd hoga hashr me
aaj wo abde qudaye zulmenan paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
chaadare rehmat hai jiski zaate ummat ke liye
aaj is dunya me wo aata e taaham paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
zeenate arshe ilaahi malike naare o jinaa'n
lahad e yazdaa'n sahibe loho qalam paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ka markab raakibe doshe shahe loulaak hai
aaj wo zee shoukat o shaan o hasham paida hua
